video_title: Derrick White Details His Celtics Journey and Talks Chris Cenac Jr.'s Upside

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on his gratitude for playing for the Boston Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I've been really thankful and grateful to put on the Celtics uniform and go out there
quotes.quote: I've been really thankful and grateful to put on the Celtics uniform and go out there and compete in front of the best fans in the world. Every day I go out there, I try to give my all, help us win as many games as possible, and I'm pretty fortunate to be on this team, especially at this time when we win so many games and play in so many big moments.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White reflects on his time in Boston, saying he is grateful to put on the uniform and compete in front of the best fans in the world every day.

structured.context: Derrick White reflects on his gratitude for playing for the Boston Celtics and competing in front of their fans.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the challenges of an mid-season trade to Boston
quotes.excerpt: You get traded, no matter what time you get traded, you're going to try to meet
quotes.quote: You get traded, no matter what time you get traded, you're going to try to meet so many new people, trying to figure out the roads in Boston, trying to figure out where to live, trying to figure out everything. Especially during the season, it's really difficult, so I feel like I had to hit the ground running, obviously try to figure all the stuff out, meet everybody, figure out the offense and stuff, and win as many games as possible.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White opens up about the difficulty of a mid-season trade, noting that trying to figure out life in a new city while learning a new offense on the fly is really difficult.

structured.context: Derrick White discusses the personal and professional challenges of being traded to the Boston Celtics mid-season.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the motivation to win more than one championship
quotes.excerpt: It would be a disappointment if I only won one, so that's just the great thing
quotes.quote: It would be a disappointment if I only won one, so that's just the great thing about sports is you get one, now you are trying to find the fight for the next one.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White is already looking ahead to the next title run, stating it would be a disappointment if he only won one championship with the Celtics.

structured.context: Derrick White expresses his motivation to win more than one championship with the Boston Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the evolution of his career and perspective
quotes.excerpt: It's always a good reminder of guys like Paul George and Mike Conley that have had
quotes.quote: It's always a good reminder of guys like Paul George and Mike Conley that have had unbelievable careers and done so many amazing things in the league, but how hard it is to win a championship and how many guys are still reaching or trying to get that goal. I remember when Al Horford had it one-one and we all wanted to push it for Al, so now it's like Mike and Paul, they've had amazing careers that we want to help them get something they've never done before.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White discusses the difficulty of winning a title, mentioning that he and his teammates are motivated to help veterans like Paul George and Mike Conley finally get their first championship.

structured.context: Derrick White discusses the difficulty of winning a championship and his desire to help veteran players achieve that goal.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on Chris Cenac Jr.'s professional development and upside
quotes.excerpt: He's doing a great job of listening, learning, getting better, and obviously we threw him in
quotes.quote: He's doing a great job of listening, learning, getting better, and obviously we threw him in a big-time moment last game and he did a lot of great things for us.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White praises Chris Cenac Jr. for his development, noting he is doing a great job of listening and learning after being thrown into a big-time moment in his last game.

structured.context: Derrick White praises the professional development and recent performance of teammate Chris Cenac Jr.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the keys to his elite rim protection
quotes.excerpt: Just being in the right position, timing is probably the top two things that give you
quotes.quote: Just being in the right position, timing is probably the top two things that give you an advantage, especially at my size. You're not going to block it, obviously like Victor Wembanyama or something like that, they could be out of position and still get a block, and somehow I've gotten really good timing, especially with all these slow steps and stuff, so you kind of have to figure out what the opponent is going to try to do and time it up right.
quotes.social_post: Derrick White breaks down his rim protection, explaining that since he is not Victor Wembanyama, he relies on being in the right position and having perfect timing to block shots.

structured.context: Derrick White explains the technical keys to his rim protection compared to taller players like Victor Wembanyama.
